entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker known as a blue sphinx; in Planar Chaos's alternate reality she is a white-aligned battle angel commanding a legion of angels.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Elementalist brother of Mishra who, in the alternate Dominaria, trained as an artificer under Tocasia; fought his evil progeny Gerrard.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Elementalist brother of Urza who, in the alternate Dominaria, trained as an artificer.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Mentor of the brothers Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Witch whose machinations are tied to the Elemental Invasions on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane of Urza, Mishra and Serra; an alternate reality version appears in Planar Chaos.

entities.name: Institute for Arcane Studies
entities.description: Academy once thought of as a half-charred school of pyromaniacal magelings, reinterpreted as a place of higher learning.

entities.name: Elemental Invasions
entities.description: Conflict on Dominaria that might have been avoided in the alternate timeline.

entities.name: Kev Walker
entities.description: Artist who repainted Damnation as a blast of holy sunlight for Wrath of God.
